entries.description: Gain MissingN.

entries.name: Black Belt
entries.description: On Battle Start If you have exactly 1 Fighting monster on your team, activate its On Victory ability.

entries.name: Bug Catcher
entries.description: The first Bug monster you buy each day is free.

entries.name: Burglar
entries.description: Trinket gifts only offer 2 choices, but you can take both of them.

entries.name: Chef
entries.description: Your singled-typed monsters gain Fire typing. Your Fire monsters have +2 Burn.

entries.name: Chemist
entries.description: Your Toxic monsters have +3 Poison. When any monster levels up, increase this effect by +1 Poison.

entries.name: Egg Breeder
entries.description: Gain a Purple Egg that hatches into a level 2 Super Rare monster in 5 days.

entries.name: Gamer
entries.description: Gain a Mythical monster and $30 on day 9.

entries.name: Gentleman
entries.description: From day 4 onwards, your shop no longer stocks Common or Uncommon monsters.

entries.name: Lucky Girl
entries.description: SHINY monsters are more likely to appear.

entries.name: Mad Scientist
entries.description: On day 7, transform monsters on your active team into random level 1 Legendary monsters.

entries.name: Masked Man
entries.description: Every 4 days, choose a trainer and gain their ability.

entries.name: Monster Ranger
entries.description: Start with an Uncommon monster. Get another copy of that monster every 2 days.

entries.name: Musician
entries.description: If you have exactly 1 Electric monster on your team, it will have +150% Shock.

entries.name: Painter
entries.description: Random species will be painted with every type this run.

entries.name: Redhead
entries.description: On Victory Give your Fire monsters +3 Burn permanently.

entries.name: Rich Lady
entries.description: Gain shop rank +2 and $10.

entries.name: Scavenger
entries.description: Gain an additional copy of each non-unique Common or Uncommon Trinket from a gift.

entries.name: Shopkeeper
entries.description: Your shop stocks Item 1 rarity tier higher and cost 15% less.

entries.name: Smuggler
entries.description: Batomon from other regions appear in your shop and cost 25% less.

entries.name: Swim Coach
entries.description: Gain a random Water monster each day.

entries.name: Treasure Hunter
entries.description: When you get Trinket gifts, your choices are 1 rarity tier higher.

entries.name: Twins
entries.description: When monsters merge into level 3, gain an exact copy with a sell value of 0.

entries.name: Youngster
entries.description: Gain 3 free rerolls every day.
